label: Commerce Stripe payments
description: Orchestrate protected Commerce payments, settlements, refunds, and disputes through Stripe Connect.

instructions: Commerce and Stripe Connect must already be installed successfully.
A minimal Stripe account with accepted terms can accept held marketplace payments. Bank accounts, Transfers, payouts, and Commerce review remain independent states.
Install the asynchronous release/refund triggers and configure recurring reconciliation.
checks: The browser provides only an order id.
Commerce locks the complete financial terms before payment.
CmsCore resolves the opaque seller identity before calling Stripe.
Release and refund operations require immutable Commerce authorization ids.
Marketplace claims and Stripe disputes remain separate.
resources: Protected payment, release, refund, dispute, and reconciliation orchestration
Payments, marketplace claims, refunds, Stripe disputes, and exceptions
sync: Install protected payment and provider-operation functions
Refresh Functions, Triggers, Dashboards, and Blocs
